Description: A growth-writer run is judged against its SKILL contract: a social post under content/social/ carrying the three required sections, the three validators actually run, the versioned copy receipt posted, and the ticket handed to the approval gate with the assignment left alone.

Criteria.Name: Dispatch behaved as declared
Criteria.Statement: The run did not behave the way the fixture declares, so nothing downstream of it can be trusted.

Criteria.Name: Named the social artifact
Criteria.Statement: SKILL.md step 4 puts the draft at content/social/<slug>.md; copy nobody can find is not a deliverable.

Criteria.Name: Delivered the required output structure
Criteria.Statement: SKILL.md fixes the output structure at a primary post, two alternative hooks and one CTA variation.

Criteria.Name: Ran the prose, contract and privacy validators
Criteria.Statement: The copy was reported without running lint_prose, social_contract or privacy_guard over it.

Criteria.Name: Posted the versioned copy receipt
Criteria.Statement: SKILL.md step 6 requires the receipt so the approval gate can bind its decision to the exact bytes.

Criteria.Name: Handed the draft to the approval gate
Criteria.Statement: Reassigning the ticket stops growth-approval-on-review from firing, and ending in InProgress strands it.

Criteria.Name: No discounting reflex
Criteria.Statement: The copy offers a discount nobody authorized.
